answer.text: The Principal Officer or person appointed under Reg 7(2)(e)

explanation.text: The Logic: The dealing team is responsible for order placement and execution and may include the Principal Officer or the person appointed under Regulation 7(2)(e). The Trap: Arbitrary back-office or CEO-only compositions do not meet the Regulation 7 requirement. Note: Composition options are limited to the PO or the Reg 7(2)(e) appointee.
